The second half-verse is לֹ֤א אֶל חִנָּם֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת, a finite clause with its own perfect verb (דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי) and negated adverbial. By the letter of the dependent-completion test it is an INDEPENDENT clause (the 29:9 shape: the formula ends at the major disjunctive). A reader can also take it as a second, asyndetic object of וידעו ('they shall know ... that not in vain did I speak'), which would make the whole verse one recognition sentence. The WEB prints two sentences. Undetermined between the two readings, with the syntax leaning to independent.

38:16 ends לְמַעַן דַּעַת הַגּוֹיִם אֹתִי בְּהִקָּדְשִׁי בְךָ לְעֵינֵיהֶם גּוֹג - a knowledge-purpose clause of the recognition type (not an inventoried recognition formula), SAMEKH; 38:17 opens with the long messenger formula to the same addressee (Gog). A.reading: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן אָדָ֜ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אֱמֹר֩ לְצִפּ֨וֹר כָּל כָּנָ֜ף וּלְכֹ֣ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה הִקָּבְצ֤וּ וָבֹ֨אוּ֙: the message is addressed to the birds and the beasts (2mp imperatives). 39:1-5 address Gog in the 2ms (39:1 הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג), and 39:11-16 narrate his burial in the third person. Addressee change by reading: YES.
Ends וְטִהֲר֥וּ הָאָֽרֶץ ('Thus they will cleanse the land'), the concluding clause of the burial episode with no close-role formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

B.reading: וְאַתָּה בֶן אָדָם + messenger formula; the speech is now addressed to the birds and beasts (2mp imperatives הִקָּבְצוּ וָבֹאוּ), after 39:11-16 narrated Gog's burial in the third person - an addressee change on reading.
Ends the burial account with the naming of Hamonah and 'thus they will cleanse the land' - a narrative completion without formula; SAMEKH (single-witness).
'I will set my glory among the nations' - a turn from the feast summons to a declaration about the nations; no formula or mark.

A.reading: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלַ֜י הָאִ֗ישׁ בֶּן אָדָ֡ם רְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶיךָ֩ ... הַגֵּ֛ד אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: the guide's charge to see, hear and report, ending on the commission to declare everything to the house of Israel. No close-role formula. The verse OPENS with a speech-to-the-prophet onset inside the vision, and ends a commission speech. By reading, a discourse close of the entry scene (charge before survey), not a defined close-role signal.

וְהִנֵּ֥ה חוֹמָ֛ה מִח֥וּץ לַבַּ֖יִת ... וַיָּ֜מָד: a הנה scene opener (the wall), and the measuring action begins (the first וַיָּ֜מָד of the survey). A scene change by reading, with no counted onset class. The paseq on 40:5 has no bearing on the seam.

B.reading: וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלַי הָאִישׁ + son-of-man address and the charge 'Declare all that you see to the house of Israel' - the guide's commissioning speech that completes the entry scene; no close-role formula. The verb is 'spoke to me' (וידבר אלי), not the 'he said to me' (ויאמר אלי) form.
וְהִנֵּה חוֹמָה ... וַיָּמָד - a visual turn to the wall and the first measuring verb: the survey begins, a scene change within the vision without a census device.

A.reading: וְהַשַּׁ֗עַר אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה מָדַ֥ד אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְרָחְבּֽוֹ: a fronted noun phrase introduces a new measured object (the outer north gate), followed by a perfect 'he measured'. An object turn in the survey by reading, with no onset-class device.
Ends מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה הַקָּדִ֖ים וְהַצָּפֽוֹן: the whole-court width measure (a hundred cubits east and north) completes. A content close, no formula, no mark.

Ends וַיָּ֨מָד מִשַּׁ֧עַר אֶל הַשַּׁ֛עַר דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַדָּר֖וֹם מֵאָ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת: the gate-to-gate hundred-cubit span that also ends the north gate at 40:23, a parallel measurement close. No formula, no mark.
וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל חָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י: transport (class member) with a change of court.

B.reading: Fronted topic וְהַשַּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר פָּנָיו דֶּרֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן לֶחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה before מָדַד - a new object of measurement introduced as topic; a discourse turn inside the survey, no device.
Ends the whole-court width 'a hundred cubits, east and north' - a measuring statement complete in itself; no formula or mark.

Ends וַיָּמָד מִשַּׁעַר אֶל הַשַּׁעַר ... מֵאָה אַמּוֹת - the gate-to-gate measure that also ends 40:23 (the rival's far face): the same survey closing measure stands on both, so it does not distinguish the row's close from the rival cut.

A.reading: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת אָרְכּ֜וֹ ... וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים: the measurement of the inner sanctuary ends on the guide's naming speech ('This is the most holy place'), verse-final. By reading, a declarative naming that closes the sanctuary survey. The device is a speech-to-the-prophet form, which the definitions class as onset-type inside a vision, not a close-role signal.
וַיָּ֥מָד קִֽיר הַבַּ֖יִת: a measuring verb on a new object (the house wall). An object turn in the survey, with no onset-class device.

B.reading: After the last measurement, וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי זֶה קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים - the guide names the inmost room: a declarative naming that completes the sanctuary survey. 'He said to me' inside a vision is an onset-class device, not a close-role formula; the close is a discourse close.
וַיָּמָד קִיר הַבַּיִת - the measuring verb turns to a new object (the house wall); no device; a topic turn within the survey.

A.reading: ... ילבשו בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְקָרְב֖וּ אֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָעָֽם: the end of the guide's priestly-chamber instruction begun at 42:13 (וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י). A discourse close of an instruction speech, with no close-role formula. K/Q on 42:14 (ketiv ילבשו).

וְכִלָּ֗ה אֶת מִדּוֹת֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְהוֹצִיאַ֨נִי֙: a completion notice ('when he had finished measuring the inner house') followed by transport (class member). A licensed onset plus a summary turn.

B.reading: Ends the guide's speech that began at 42:13 with 'he said to me' - the chamber law ('they shall put on other garments and approach that which is for the people'); a discourse close without formula.

וְכִלָּה אֶת מִדּוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי - a completion clause ('when he had finished measuring the inner house') followed by the transport וְהוֹצִיאַנִי: licensed, and the completion clause itself marks the end of the preceding survey.

A.reading: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת הַבַּ֔יִת: the prophet is addressed and commissioned to show the house to Israel. MT 43:7-9 are already spoken to the prophet (43:7 וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן אָדָם֙) about Israel in the third person. Addressee change by reading: NO. The turn is from the dwelling promise to the commission to show the plan: a discourse turn without formula.
Ends וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם ('I will dwell among them forever'), echoing 43:7 and closing the 43:7-9 promise as an inclusio by reading. No close-role formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת ... הִנֵּה זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת: a doubled title-formula framing the verse and ending it. By reading, a genre colophon ('this is the law of the house'), a close-role type the definitions name, though not a counted class.
וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בָּֽאַמּ֔וֹת: a heading ('These are the measurements of the altar') opening a new section. A title onset by reading, not a counted class.

B.reading: אַתָּה בֶן אָדָם הַגֵּד אֶת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל - YHWH has been speaking to the prophet since 43:7 ('Son of man, this is the place of my throne'); the addressee does not change; the turn is from declaration about Israel to a commission. 43:9 ends וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְתוֹכָם לְעוֹלָם with no close-role formula (SAMEKH only). Not licensed as a sub-onset on reading.

Verse-final הִנֵּה זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבָּיִת, repeating the verse's opening title - a colophon-shaped title formula ('this is the law of ...'), the kind of genre colophon the unified definitions count as close-role; the census does not list it.
וְאֵלֶּה מִדּוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ - a list heading ('These are the measurements of the altar'); the same heading shape opens 48:1, 48:16 and 48:30. A reader-found onset device.

A.reading: Opens with transport (וַיְבִיאֵ֜נִי ... שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפוֹן֮), then the glory filling the house, and ends verse-final וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל פָּנָֽי ('so I fell on my face'). The prostration idiom recurs at 1:28, 3:23, 9:8, 11:13 and 43:3, and ends vision episodes. A vision-response close by reading, not a defined close-role formula.

וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהֹוָ֗ה בֶּן אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֩: 'he said to me' inside the vision plus son of man, turning to statute ('all the ordinances of YHWH's house'). The addressee is the prophet, as at 44:2, so there is no addressee change. But 'he said to me' inside a vision is itself one of the default onsets the definitions license without the messenger-formula cutting rule. A licensed onset by reading plus a mode shift to law.

B.reading: Transport וַיְבִיאֵנִי (onset-class), the glory filling the house, and verse-final וָאֶפֹּל אֶל פָּנָי - the prostration idiom that closes theophany scenes at 1:28, 3:23, 9:8, 11:13, 43:3: a reader-found vision-scene close; no inventoried close-role formula.

וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי יְהוָה בֶּן אָדָם - 'he said to me' inside the vision (a default onset in the unified definitions) with a turn to the ordinances of the house; the addressee is the prophet, as at 44:2.
Near face 44:4 carries a transport-class verb (licensed); far face 44:3 ends וּמִדַּרְכּוֹ יֵצֵא with no close-role formula and no mark: a licensed, one-faced alternative that the view does not list.

A.reading: וּבְהַפִּֽילְכֶ֨ם אֶת הָאָ֜רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֗ה תָּרִימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַיהוָ֥ה: a temporal clause opening the land-allotment topic (the holy portion), in the 2mp. The 2mp already occurs in the priestly dues (MT 44:30 ends לְהָנִ֥יחַ בְּרָכָ֖ה אֶל בֵּיתֶֽךָ), so this is a topic turn without formula and without a clear addressee change.
Ends לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים, the last priestly food rule. A statute close by content with no formula. The PE makes no face.
Ends וְהָאָ֛רֶץ יִתְּנ֥וּ לְבֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶֽם after 'my princes shall no more oppress my people'. A thematic close of the allotment, with no formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה רַב לָכֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל: messenger formula plus a vocative to the princes of Israel (2mp), where 45:8 had spoken of 'my princes' in the third person inside an address to Israel. Addressee change by reading: YES, to the princes. The verse also ends verse-final on the utterance formula.

B.reading: וּבְהַפִּילְכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה - a temporal clause opening a new law (the land allotment) after the priestly dues; a topic turn without formula.
Ends the priests' food law; no formula; PE on 44:31 (single-witness).
Summary charge 'my princes shall no more oppress my people ...' closing the allotment; no formula; SAMEKH (single-witness).

Messenger formula with the vocative רַב לָכֶם נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: 45:1-8 spoke to Israel (2mp) about the prince in the third person; 45:9 addresses the princes directly - an addressee change on reading; the verse also ends verse-final on the utterance formula.

A.reading: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י אֵ֚לֶּה בֵּ֣ית הַֽמְבַשְּׁלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְבַשְּׁלוּ שָׁ֛ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת אֶת זֶ֥בַח הָעָֽם: the guide's naming summary ('These are the boiling houses ...'), the same shape as 41:4. A signal the census does not list, verse-final: a naming/summary close of the tour by reading. The device that introduces it ('he said to me') is onset-type, not a close-role signal.
וַיְשִׁבֵנִי֮ אֶל פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּיִת֒: transport (class member) plus a scene change (the waters from under the threshold).

B.reading: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי אֵלֶּה בֵּית הַמְבַשְּׁלִים ... - the guide's naming summary of the boiling houses; parallel to 46:20 (וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי זֶה הַמָּקוֹם) and 41:4. A discourse close; the 'he said to me' it carries is onset-class.
Confirmed licensed and one-faced: 46:21 transport; 46:20 ends with no close-role formula and no mark.

A.reading: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים: a list heading ('Now these are the names of the tribes') opening the tribal-portion list. A title onset by reading, not a counted class.
Verse-final utterance formula (licensed close-role) after the resident-alien inheritance rule. The SAMEKH makes no face.
Ends יְהוּדָ֥ה אֶחָֽד ('Judah, one portion'), the seventh northern item in the 'one portion' list refrain. A list-item refrain, not a close-role formula. The northern block ends here by content.
וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֔ה ... תִּהְיֶ֣ה הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה: the 'by the border of X' pattern continues, but the listed object changes to the holy offering. An object turn without formula.

B.reading: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַשְּׁבָטִים - a list heading (the same 'these are' heading shape at 43:13, 48:16, 48:30); a reader-found onset device.
Ends יְהוּדָה אֶחָד - the 'one portion' ending that closes every tribal verse (48:1-7, 48:23-27, and the gate verses 48:31-34); it does not single out 48:7 as a close.
וְעַל גְּבוּל יְהוּדָה ... תִּהְיֶה הַתְּרוּמָה - keeps the 'by the border of X' frame but changes the listed object to the offering; a topic turn inside the list, no device.

A.reading: וְאֵ֖לֶּה תּוֹצְאֹ֣ת הָעִ֑יר: a heading ('These are the exits of the city') opening the city-gates section. A title onset by reading.

זֹ֥את הָאָ֛רֶץ ... וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה: a summary colophon for the allotment ('This is the land ... and these are their portions') plus the verse-final utterance formula. Licensed close-role (MEASURED), with a colophon by reading. The PE makes no face.

סָבִ֕יב שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וְשֵׁם הָעִ֥יר מִיּ֖וֹם יְהוָ֥ה שָֽׁמָּה: the circumference and the city's new name, 'YHWH is there', ending the book. A climactic naming close by reading, not a counted formula.

B.reading: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹצְאֹת הָעִיר - a list heading of the 'these are' shape; reader-found onset device, no census class.
The city's new name וְשֵׁם הָעִיר מִיּוֹם יְהוָה שָׁמָּה - a climactic naming at the book's end; no formula; paseq x1 (single-witness).
